blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateCustomerStoreCreditAccountStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that a customer's store credit account exists and has a positive
balance. It throws an error if the account is not found or has no balance.

children.name: ValidateCustomerStoreCreditAccountStepInput
children.description: Input to validate that a customer's store credit account exists and has a positive balance.
